trends.name: Lagarde’s Resignation
trends.why: Multiple outlets across Europe and Asia report the ECB president stepping down, signaling a major shift in EU monetary policy leadership.

trends.name: HTX UK Promotion Ban
trends.why: Cointelegraph and Channel NewsAsia both cover the FCA’s enforcement action, highlighting tightening crypto marketing rules in the UK.

trends.name: Bitcoin Price & Options Expiry
trends.why: CoinDesk and Cointelegraph report a sharp price dip and options market dynamics, indicating heightened volatility ahead of expiry.

trends.name: Algeria Troop Deployment to Niger
trends.why: The Africa Report and other African outlets cover Algeria’s military move, underscoring geopolitical shifts in West Africa.

trends.name: Nigeria Investment Promotion Commission Reconstitution
trends.why: BusinessDay Nigeria reports a government‑initiated board overhaul, reflecting Nigeria’s focus on attracting investment.

trends.name: EU Crypto Investor Survey
trends.why: Cointelegraph highlights EU investors preferring crypto over traditional retirement vehicles, indicating a shift in wealth‑creation preferences.

trends.name: Bitcoin Legal Status in Thailand
trends.why: CoinDesk reports a landmark Thai court ruling, setting a precedent for crypto legal recognition in Southeast Asia.

trends.name: ECB Tokenised Collateral Initiative
trends.why: Bank of England coverage of ECB’s approach signals a broader European move toward digital asset integration in central banking.
